mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (current level below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals economic weakness that triggers a flight to quality, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) relative to their 3-month moving averages signals a sharp economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO occurs in 70% of cases without negative 20-day SPX returns (p-value > 0.05 for negative correlation).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's aggressive policy tightening causes a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average (p-value > 0.05 for positive mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 950,000 units signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 950.0 (p-value > 0.05 for negative mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE occurs in 70% of cases without negative 20-day SPX returns (p-value > 0.05 for negative correlation).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100 (p-value > 0.05 for negative mean return).
